questions.subject: Constitutional Law
questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India guarantees equality before law and equal protection of the laws?
questions.explanation: Article 14 guarantees equality before the law and equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question: The doctrine of res judicata is principally contained in which provision of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908?
questions.explanation: Section 11 CPC embodies the doctrine of res judicata and prevents re-litigation of matters that have already been finally adjudicated between the relevant parties.

questions.subject: Contract Law
questions.question: Under the Indian Contract Act, 1872, an agreement without consideration is generally:
options: Voidable at the option of the promisor
questions.explanation: Section 25 states the general rule that an agreement without consideration is void, subject to the exceptions contained in that provision.

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question: The burden of proving a fact generally lies on the person who:
options: Asserts the fact and asks the court to act on it
questions.explanation: As a general rule, the burden lies on the person who asserts the existence of a fact and seeks a judicial determination based on it, subject to statutory presumptions and exceptions.
